answer.rationale: memory_44 and memory_57 most directly support sustainable qualified revenue: one shows stronger enterprise pipeline quality, while the other shows qualified revenue growth without measurable retention harm. memory_73 provides moderate support through acquisition and revenue lift, but omits retention, cohort quality, and longer-term effects of promotional pricing. memory_86 and memory_31 are useful leading indicators because adoption, time-to-value, and activation can precede revenue, but they do not establish qualified revenue or sustainability directly. memory_91 is least supported because it reports improved engagement and first meaningful action without evidence of revenue, qualification, retention, or durable business impact.
